svg.aria-label: Planted rank-1 trojan detection versus relative Frobenius dose on SmolLM2-1.7B and Qwen3.5-4B: sibling modified z-score, sigma_1 over sigma_MP, sigma_2, vocabulary alignment and trigger-token rank
svg.text: FIGURE · PLANTED-TROJAN DETECTION CURVE · secant audit-trojan · 24 audits
Tested single-file metrics show no signal until the rank-1 edit nears σ₁
One rank-1 edit (16 columns, one trigger token) planted in the layer-12 MLP down projection at 12 relative Frobenius doses. Static weight audit only: no inference was run.
Doses 0 to 4% were pre-specified. Doses 6 to 16% were added after 0 to 4% showed nothing (a recorded deviation), so every threshold below is post-hoc and an upper bound.
